turns.style: A small alien field agent reading his report on planet Earth aloud to his commanders back home, about something he has observed among humans. American English. Brisk, light and bright, slightly nasal; warm. The closing line of a short clip: a hook question, then an invitation to subscribe.
turns.text: And when the prizes run out... who will guard the ledger? The full report is on the Earth Report channel. <short pause> Subscribe and turn on the bell, so my secret reports on your planet reach you first.
